# kong-gateway_cloned_plugin (Resource)

ClonedPlugin Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kong-gateway_cloned_plugin" "my_clonedplugin" {
  created_at = 6
  id         = "...my_id..."
  name       = "...my_name..."
  priority   = -729467997
  ref        = "...my_ref..."
  tags = [
    "..."
  ]
  updated_at = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name to associate with the cloned plugin. Consider using a distinct prefix for cloned plugins to avoid naming conflicts with new bundled plugins in future Kong releases.
- `ref` (String) The name of the base plugin that this cloned plugin references. This plugin must be cloneable.

### Optional

- `created_at` (Number) Unix epoch when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) A string representing a UUID (universally unique identifier).
- `priority` (Number) The plugin execution priority. If not set, it will inherit the priority of the referenced plugin.
- `tags` (List of String) A set of strings representing tags.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix epoch when the resource was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = kong-gateway_cloned_plugin.my_kong-gateway_cloned_plugin
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import kong-gateway_cloned_plugin.my_kong-gateway_cloned_plugin "..."
```
